description: This file contains CSS styles for a theme management system, defining variables and styles for both light and dark themes as well as responsive design elements for a Tic Tac Toe frontend application.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main container for the application, styling for background, text color, and layout properties.

classes.name: App-header
classes.description: Header section of the application, styling for background color, layout, and alignment.

classes.name: App-logo
classes.description: Styling for the application logo, includes size and animation properties.

classes.name: App-link
classes.description: Link styling within the application, defining color and transition effects.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: Styling for the button that toggles between themes, including position, appearance, and hover effects.
